title: PayloadV2
description: Sanitized payload sent from the extension to the Aegis server. This object is the ONLY thing that crosses the network boundary. It may contain tokens ([[PII:TYPE:xxxxxxxx]]) and redacted pixels, never raw PII.

session.description: Opaque per-session id. Not derived from user identity.

capture_id.description: Identifies one observation of one screen state.

task.description: The user's task, already tokenized. May contain tokens.

url.description: Sanitized URL. Query/fragment PII is tokenized or stripped.

type.description: Coarse page classification, e.g. kyc_form, checkout, login.

elements.description: Set-of-Marks elements. Labels are sanitized; raw values are never included.

visual_regions.description: Regions produced by the local vision detector.

redactions.description: Every redaction applied to the image, declared so the server can reason about what it cannot see.

image.description: Redacted screenshot as a data URL. Omitted in image-only-off or text-delta routing.

texts.description: Sanitized visible text blocks, capped by TEXT_BUDGET_CHARS (see extension/shared/config.ts).

mode.description: Routing mode. Trades latency against perception depth.

bbox.description: Axis-aligned box [x, y, w, h] in CSS pixels relative to the viewport.

valueLenBucket.description: Coarse length bucket. Never the value, never the exact length.

fp.description: Stable element fingerprint used to reacquire the element before acting. Not a selector and not derived from page id/class names.

role.description: Accessibility role, e.g. textbox, button, combobox.

label.description: Sanitized accessible name. May contain tokens.

input_type.description: Input type, e.g. text, email, password. Drives token type matching on re-hydration.

has_value.description: Whether the field currently holds a value. The value itself is never sent.

hidden_interactive.description: Interactive in the DOM but not visible to the user. Flagged as a possible injection/clickjacking vector.

value_token.description: Token standing in for this field's value (Stage 2). Present only when policy decided TOKEN/TOKEN_WITH_APPROVAL for it; the raw value is never sent.

occluded.description: On screen but covered by something else. The planner should clear the obstacle before acting on this element.

covered_by.description: EID of the element covering this one, when that element is itself in this payload.

rid.description: Region id, unique within the capture.

class.description: Detector class, e.g. button, face, id_document, card, signature, qr, or unscanned_media (the Stage 2 fail-closed default for images/canvas/video/embeds/unmapped iframes, until Stage 6 vision can classify them).

ocr.description: OCR text for detector-only regions, already tokenized.

kind.description: FILL = solid fill over text PII. LABELLED_FILL = solid fill with the type/token drawn inside it. BLUR = irreversible blur, faces only. FILL_REGION = solid fill over a whole document/card region.

type.description: PII type that triggered the redaction, e.g. AADHAAR, FACE, PASSWORD.

reason.description: Why the policy fired. Must not restate the redacted value.

token.description: When the masked value was tokenized, the token the server can correlate this masked region with.

piiToken.description: An HMAC token minted by the extension's vault. See AGENTS.md invariant 3.

tid.description: Text block id, unique within the capture.

role.description: Accessibility role of the block element (paragraph, cell, heading...).

text.description: Sanitized block text. May contain tokens; never raw PII.
